_comment: Update this file whenever you upload a new APK/IPA to /app. Shown on GET /app.

items.text: Web: Spotify-style playback in the browser — play here on laptop/phone, or choose Play on speaker…
Android: playlist Play starts on this phone; speaker controls work without serial mapping
Android: Now Playing focuses this phone; play restarts if the audio service stopped
Android: playlist tracks play the full queue from the tapped song
Android: progress bar advances during remote/streaming playback (library duration fallback when ExoPlayer lacks stream metadata)
Android: skip next/previous reliably starts the new track (recover from ENDED/IDLE)
Android: Search tab loads genres and new releases first, then enriches in background
Mix Muse — conversational AI playlists from Claude or OpenAI (prompt or “sounds like this song/album/playlist”)
Resonance — library-native similar-vibe mixes and endless radio (genre, year, duration, loudness)
Discover Weekly, Release Radar, and Continue Listening on home (iOS, Android, web)
Playlist folders, expanded smart rules, unified search with suggestions
Playback handoff — move listening between phone and speakers
Driving mode + Android Auto browse; CarPlay templates (iOS)
Optional loudness normalization on stream (night mode / kid-safe rooms)
Long-press songs, albums, or playlists for Mix Muse / Resonance (Android & iOS)
All lyrics use karaoke view: real LRC when available, smooth scroll for the rest
Synced lyrics: current line bold, auto-scroll, ±0.5s timing adjust
Smarter LRCLIB matching (retries, normalized titles, prefers timed lyrics)
Android: pause → skip tracks → play now resumes correctly
Android: switching playlists while another is playing works reliably
Device picker stays open until you pick a speaker (Android & iOS)
Household profiles, room policies, and kid song requests
Lyrics panel on Android Now Playing (LRCLIB + sidecar .lrc)
Unified source/playlist metadata line for local playback
